name: protobuf_peek
description: Decode a protobuf blob without its schema: field numbers, wire types and values, with nested messages unwrapped and length-delimited fields read as text where they are text. For the Android and iOS artefacts that stopped being SQLite.

path.description: A file holding one protobuf message

hex.description: The message as hex, instead of a file

offset.description: Start decoding at this byte offset

max_depth.description: How deep to unwrap nested messages (default 6)
